German solar manufacturer Solarwatt has added a new glass-glass module to its Construct series for building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV). The module features bifacial TOPCon cells, delivers up to 227 W/m² and has received general building approval in Germany.

title: Salt-based thermal storage supports renewable steam in Spain
summary:
A renewable steam project at Bayer’s pharmaceutical plant in Spain combines salt-based thermal storage with a 15 MW renewable power purchase agreement (PPA) and 2.5 MW of on-site solar, in an effort to replace fossil fuels used for industrial heat.

title: Tongwei unveils 26.03%-efficient TOPCon solar cell with high sheet resistance
summary:
The solar cell was fabricated using a low-cost photoresist-based etching process to create a selective emitter with a sheet resistance of up to 1,600 Ω/sq in non-contacted regions, reducing recombination losses while maintaining effective electrical contacts. The TOPCon device achieved a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.03% and an open-circuit voltage of 746.5 mV.
